'''New Otoh Gunga''' was the main and first [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[City/Legends|city]] built on [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]] during the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] [[Colonization of Ohma-D'un/Legends|colonization]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==History==
When [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] had to deal with [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga's]] overpopulation, he decided to launch a colonization project on [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]], so he sent [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|the Queen of the Naboo]] to help and set up a stable ecosystem on the empty [[Moon/Legends|moon]], and establish the new [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[City/Legends|city]].

The settlement was built underwater, just like its namesake, Otoh Gunga, made of many [[Hydrostatic bubble/Legends|hydrostatic bubbles]]. Two of these bubble buildings were erected [[Queen's Monument|to honor Queen Amidala]] and [[Jedi monument (Ohma-D'un)|Obi-Wan]].
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the entire city's population was nearly killed by the deadly [[swamp gas]], a weapon developed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].
